decisions.summary: One file per bundle: every copy inline in MANIFEST.md under its origin; contracts say read it once; proven by a one-file seeded leg of three runs per agent (T26, T31)
decisions.why: R2 rec 1 asks for a single file holding every copy inline under its origin heading so a check reads it in one turn, and a seeded re-run of three a leg; built as that. The file name MANIFEST.md rather than BUNDLE.md is not a change of substance.

decisions.summary: The glossary variant index and a source's saved pages stay files beside the MANIFEST (grep targets), not inlined; quote-verbatim.json stays a file (its report is inlined as quote-verbatim.txt)
decisions.why: Narrows R2's 'every copy inline'. Legitimate on the purpose test: the GM adopted the five to cut token cost ('let's see if that helps'), and R2 rec 1's mechanism is fewer turns because every turn re-reads the whole context. Inlining a grep target puts it in the context of every later turn: glossary-variants.txt is 23,661 bytes (measured 2026-09-26, wc -c), larger than the 040 bundle's fragment or notes, and saved pages are whole source pages whose grep-not-read form the GM adopted in feature 255. Adjudicated separately: variant index - literal inlining would add ~6k tokens to every turn of every check, defeating the purpose; saved pages - same, and reading them whole reverses a GM-adopted rule; quote-verbatim.json - a machine duplicate of the inlined .txt report, so nothing a check reads is withheld. Every file a check READS whole is inlined (checked in _check_bundle.inline).

decisions.summary: Two sessions per page: write brief (locate, read, write) and check brief (check, apply, close) joined by a handoff; make page-session runs several briefs in order
decisions.why: R2 rec 2 is 'write, then check-and-apply', the second session fresh and starting from the committed fragments; D11 and briefs/vegetation-1.md, -2.md implement that split. The sequential runner is the mechanism for running both, not added scope.

decisions.summary: Skill CLAUDE.md body moves to l7r/diagram/CLAUDE.md; pool/ and tests/ import it; skill CLAUDE.md becomes a short index; nothing in the doctrine changes
decisions.why: R2 rec 3: content belongs to l7r/diagram/ and pool/, a short skill-level index stays. Verified: the moved body differs from the old one only in link targets plus a header comment (diff with links normalized); the index is short. The tests/ import extends rather than narrows - tests/ never lies under research/, so it costs a research session nothing and keeps the dev loop where test work had it.

decisions.summary: make notes PAGE= SECTION= KEYS= prints named notes and their carrying blocks; briefs say use it and never dump a notes file
decisions.why: R2 rec 4 exactly; Makefile target and _check_bundle.print_notes exist, both briefs carry the instruction.

decisions.summary: check-bundle NOTES=<keys> cuts notes, fragment and quote-verbatim report to the named notes; the check brief's re-check uses it
decisions.why: R2 rec 5 ('quote-verbatim NOTES= and a note-scoped bundle ... check the corrected notes alone'); implemented in entry_bundle/scoped_verbatim and used at vegetation-2.md step 30.

decisions.summary: The next measured page is vegetation (five FR-002, one FR-006), two sessions, measured with tokens.py against R1 and R2, recorded as R3 (T32, T33)
decisions.why: The GM: 'then do another measured page, the same as this round, and then let's see if that helps'. Same measurement as R2, compared against it; worked in two sessions because the GM adopted rec 2.

decisions.summary: T19 now excludes homesteads and vegetation, runs two sessions per page, and is cut when T33's figures are read
decisions.why: Drops nothing: every page assertions.py names is still covered (homesteads by T18, vegetation by T32, the rest by T19), one task per page and the five research boxes are kept; two sessions follows the adopted rec 2; waiting for T33 follows 'then let's see if that helps'.
